title: Combined runtime supervisor
responsibility: Own the lifecycle of the two processes that make up a running Kiln: validate the project and settings, choose and prove a port, start the browser launcher with a private stdin pipe so it cannot consume the operator's typing, wait for identity-confirmed readiness, start Pi in the outer project root with the terminal inherited, begin or resume the recorded planning session, and on exit or signal stop both process trees within bounded grace periods and remove only what this invocation created.
notes: ⚠️ ONE TERMINAL, TWO PROCESSES, AND ONLY ONE MAY READ IT. If the background launcher inherits stdin it will eat the authentication answer or the first planning message. ⚠️ PI'S WORKING DIRECTORY IS THE OUTER PROJECT, never the tool clone, and the self-hosting checkout — where those two are the same directory — is refused unless explicitly opted into. F122 (2026-09-16): CI run 35097288227, at commit b8b09b2, windows-latest node 22, natural mode. The launch preflight timed out on the primed WMI route at 10,009.7 ms with no rows, and the supervisor refused with process-table-not-primed before either Pi or the launcher was spawned. ACC-0081's 10-second preflight bound held as specified, so the criterion outcome stands. This is the second primed-route timeout event that EVD-0109's recorded rule names: WMI is withdrawn as the Windows identity strategy and replaced wholesale by a WMI-free identity format, delivered as a separate correction. The later green run 35141902017 does not cancel it. Interactive session recovery for ACC-0103 is paused until the replacement is green.
